## Overview

- Fix opening exported files from the Canvas.
- Prepare the Awesome Copilot external plugin at the shared product version 4.2.2.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. Update version-pinned installation links to `v4.2.2`.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.2`. |
| Canvas export | Use the updated Canvas export controls when opening generated files. |
